summary: Repaired the relational model and implemented authenticated employee, department and owned leave CRUD with current database roles, bounded scoped reads and strict request validation.

Added version-conditional writes, transactional audits, manager-cycle and last-active-HR safeguards, reference-aware deletion, employee deactivation and intentional separation of employee records from login provisioning.

Implemented inclusive date overlap checks with employee row locks and a PostgreSQL exclusion constraint, plus authorized approval/rejection/cancellation transitions that retain the deciding actor and reject competing stale decisions.

Built a complete responsive React workspace with memory-only sessions, role-appropriate forms, separate preserved drafts, explicit conflict reconciliation/export, confirmed destructive actions and independent save/refresh feedback.

Added generated non-overwriting local setup, a fresh dedicated migration and repeatable fictional seed, 76 passing checks, reviewed desktop/narrow screenshots and nine detailed project-specific learning documents.

checks.environment: Node 22.16.0; Prisma 6.19.2; PostgreSQL 18; React 18; Vite 5.4.21; Playwright 1.60 Chromium
checks.command: node scripts/test-database.mjs verify; final browser-only rerun after stable accessible-name locator correction (54 backend, 8 frontend, 3 setup, 11 browser; builds; seed twice; owned cluster shutdown)

limits: Local generated demo credentials and process-local sign-in throttling; no MFA, refresh tokens, invitations, server-side token revocation or production deployment. Current role/activity is checked per request without atomic in-flight revocation.

Fresh dedicated PostgreSQL migration requiring btree_gist; no upgrade of unknown existing data, power-loss certification or comprehensive accessibility audit. Docker configuration was not exercised with a daemon.

New employee records do not provision passwords. Reference choices are bounded to 500 with a truncation warning. Review has a schema model only; leave balances, holidays, entitlements and payroll are unimplemented.
No durable create idempotency, automatic draft import/merge or full historical snapshots; audit retains change metadata.
